documentation.notes: Each profile mirrors `lms load` flags. switch_env_var switches the active main model when set truthy; default_keep_on models stay loaded; default_main is the model LMSTUDIO_MAIN_MODEL and the default active slot resolve to.

lms_load_option_reference.model_key: Argument to lms load / served id (e.g. qwen3.8-27b).
lms_load_option_reference.gpu: off | max | float 0..1 — fraction of layers on GPU (llama.cpp offload).
lms_load_option_reference.speculative_draft_mtp: --speculative-draft-mtp — use the model's native MTP draft head when available.
lms_load_option_reference.ttl: --ttl — seconds idle before unload (omit or 0 to keep loaded).
lms_load_option_reference.identifier: --identifier — API alias for this loaded instance.
lms_load_option_reference.switch_env_var: Environment variable that, when truthy, makes this the active main model.
lms_load_option_reference.default_install: Selected for installation in the default (non-interactive) install.
lms_load_option_reference.default_keep_on: Kept loaded at all times (not part of the switchable main slot).
lms_load_option_reference.default_main: The default active main model and the target of LMSTUDIO_MAIN_MODEL.
lms_load_option_reference.default_startup: Autoloaded into memory at boot. When omitted, falls back to default_keep_on || default_main. Set false to ship a model installed-but-idle while keeping it runtime-switchable via its switch_env_var.
